Bernardo Carpio

Bernardo Carpio is a legendary figure in Philippine Mythology who is said to be the cause of earthquakes. There are numerous versions of this tale. Some versions say Bernardo Carpio is a giant, as supported by the enormous footsteps he has reputedly left behind in the mountains of Montalban. Others say he was the size of an ordinary man. However, all versions agree he had a strength that was similar to that of Hercules.

This is Sundanese (one of 300-ish ethnicity in Indonesia) folklore called Sangkuriang. Sit nicely boys and girls :)

Long, long, time ago, lived a beautiful girl named Dayang sumbi. So pretty that a prince want her to be his wife. But the prince is not a human prince as he is a prince from heaven (Kahyangan) and since he is some sort of a god, he is actually can't live with humans. So then he asked permission to his father, and granted, with a condition that when they have a child, the prince will be cursed and become a dog. Such a hard choice, but thinking of Dayang Sumbi he submitted to his father curse.

So, they married and lived happily. And a baby boy was born. The prince is cursed and transformed into a dog, become a pet named Tumang. Their son, a gorgeous little boy was named Sangkuriang. He become a good hunter and diligent in collecting fruit for food. On one hunting day, he missed a shot and killed Tumang instead. As Dayang Sumbi hasn't seen Tumang for a while, she was asking Sangkuriang the dog's whereabout. Confronted, he admitted that he accidently killed Tumang. Shocked with the death of her husband, Dayang Sumbi hit Sangkuriang's head with a weaving tool and cried histerically.

Sangkuriang is neglected by his mother and have him astounded why did his mother took so much care to the dog rather onto him. He then decided to runaway from home. The next day, Dayang Sumbi felt better and stop crying. But he can't seems to find Sangkuriang. Exhausted, she fell asleep and in her dream she met her husband saying, "Don't be sad, Dayang Sumbi. Go find my body in the woods and take my heart out. Soak it with water and use the water to bathe so you will be forever young." As she wakes up, she's confused but decided to follow the dream and she becomes forever young and even more beautiful.

A long, long, time has past since. Sangkuriang is travelling so far away and so much has changed. He stops by to rest in a village and fell in love to a beautiful girl. She also fell into him. Little that he know that she's actually his own mother, Dayang Sumbi. One hunting day, she asked him to open his headband first. She is startled as she saw a scar mark similar to Sangkuriang as she hit him in the head.

After the young man left, Dayang Sumbi prays for guidance. She is then convinced that he really is Sangkuriang and thinking of an excuse to cancel the wedding. Dayang Sumbi didn't want to say it straight as she didn't want him to be sad again. So she asks an impossible task for him to marry her. She asked for a great lake with a boat built overnight.

Surprisingly, Sangkuriang didn't hesitate for the request. As during his travel he studied magial arts, with the helps of magical creatures he builds a dam to create a lake. Then he proceeds to build the huge boat. Dayang Sumbi is spying and become concerned that he could actually finish the tasks. She then ask women on the eastern village to wave a long red scarf making it looks like dawn is coming. Even the birds and farmers is deceived by the false dawn, ready for a new day.

Afraid to the coming dawn, the magical creatures cease the work and ran to cover from the sun. Sangkuriang is furiously mad and kicked the unfinished boat which then sit upturned on the lakeside.

So these days, in the city of Bandung we could see the upturned-boat shaped mountain and the trace of dam and the lake. There are a lot of version on the story but this one is simpler.

Stories like that are always so interesting because you wonder what the kernel of truth was in the beginning that started them. There would be so many other simpler ways to explain a boat shaped mountain and lake, but instead someone created a story about a god like being turning into a dog, then threw in an Oedipal situation, a Herculean feat, magical creatures and a long red scarf. Fascinating.
